lanes.name: rt-server
lanes.goal:
td-components v0.88.0 ships (ProseMirror comment editor: bold, italic, underline, strike, link) for the dsuite site. dsuite's server sanitizes the submitted HTML again with symfony/html-sanitizer ^8.1, and needs the SAME allowlist as the client. Your lane = the server side of that contract. READ FIRST: docs/internal/plans/v0.88.0-rich-text.md (sections 'Lane B', 'PHP (lane B, Codex r1 #2 #3)') and the ALREADY COMMITTED interface src/form/rich-text/rich-text-policy.js (RICH_TEXT_POLICY, resolveFeatures, isSafeUrl, policyFor, normalizeLinkTarget) — do NOT modify it; if it blocks you, STOP and report. Deliver: 1. scripts/build-rich-text-policy.mjs: writes src/form/rich-text/rich-text-policy.json = JSON.stringify(RICH_TEXT_POLICY, null, 2) + '\n' (imported from the JS module, so JS is the single source); `--check` exits 1 when stale (pattern: scripts/build-rich-text-engine.mjs). Read/write the JSON ONLY via readGenerated / writeGenerated from scripts/safe-file.mjs (symlink-safe, Codex security requirement). Run it and commit the JSON. 2. test/fixtures/rich-text/malicious.json (>= 25 cases) and canonical.json (>= 10): arrays of { name, input, features (array, default all five), allowHttp?, linkTarget? ('none' default), expected, serverExpected? }. `expected` = the CLIENT canonical HTML by these rules (the client lane implements exactly them; the main session will reconcile any case after merge): document =

blocks; inline content outside a block is wrapped in one

;
= hard break; tags only p, br, strong (from strong/b), em (from em/i), u, s (from s/strike/del), a (href only + rel="nofollow noopener" always + target when linkTarget is _self/_blank, attribute order href, rel, target); mark nesting order outermost→innermost: a, strong, em, u, s; disabled features drop the tag but keep its text; unsafe href (isSafeUrl null) drops the but keeps text; all other elements dropped keeping their text (script/style/template/iframe/object/svg/math content dropped entirely incl. text); whitespace runs collapse to one space; text escaped as innerHTML does (& < > and U+00A0 as  ); empty document → ''. Cover: script, style, on* handlers, style/class/id/data-* attrs, javascript: (case, tab, newline, entity-encoded javascript:, leading control chars), data:, vbscript:, //protocol-relative, backslash hosts, svg/math, iframe, img onerror, form/input, nested , incoming rel/target replaced, http with and without allowHttp, mailto/tel/relative/#, disabled-feature cases, linkTarget none/_self/_blank. 3. php/td-rich-text-policy.php: namespace TdComponents, final class RichTextPolicy, PHP >= 8.0 syntax only (CI job php80 lints it), NO composer require: load(string $jsonPath): array (validate version === 1, throw on bad JSON); symfonyConfig(array $policy, array $features, bool $allowHttp = false, string $linkTarget = 'none'): \Symfony\Component\HtmlSanitizer\HtmlSanitizerConfig — unknown feature or linkTarget outside none|_self|_blank → InvalidArgumentException; Symfony class missing → LogicException with a clear message; config = allowElement exactly the tags/attrs of policyFor semantics (p, br always; a gets only href), allowLinkSchemes(schemes), allowRelativeLinks(true), forceAttribute('a','rel','nofollow noopener'), linkTarget != none → forceAttribute('a','target',$linkTarget); check the real Symfony 8.1 API (method names/immutability: each with* returns a new instance) in the installed vendor code, do not guess. Header docblock like php/td.php (usage example, PHP 8.0, no composer dependency). 4. test/php/symfony/composer.json (requires symfony/html-sanitizer ^8.1, php >=8.4.1) + a runner PHP script there that loads the fixtures, builds the config per case, sanitizes `input`, prints JSON results; vendor/ and composer.lock gitignored INSIDE test/php/symfony (add a .gitignore there). test/php/td-rich-text-policy.test.js (node --test, use test/php/php.mjs helpers / HAS_PHP like other test/php files): (a) PHP 8.0-safe tests: load() errors, symfonyConfig argument validation, LogicException when Symfony is absent; (b) Symfony fixture suite: runs only when test/php/symfony/vendor exists; with env TD_REQUIRE_SYMFONY=1 a missing vendor FAILS (never skips). Compare server output to (serverExpected ?? expected) semantically: parse both with a small normalizer (same tags, attributes as sets, text) — Symfony may format differently; where Symfony genuinely differs (e.g. it does not wrap stray text in

), record serverExpected in the fixture with a short `note`. SECURITY bar: no fixture's server output may contain a script, an on* attribute, a style attribute, or a javascript:/data:/vbscript: href — assert that explicitly for every case. 5. .github/workflows/test.yml: new job `php84-symfony` modelled on the existing `php80` job (same pinned action SHAs; setup-php '8.4', tools: composer), steps: composer install --no-interaction --working-dir test/php/symfony, then node --test test/php/td-rich-text-policy.test.js with TD_REQUIRE_SYMFONY=1 and TD_REQUIRE_PHP=1. Also add `php -l php/td-rich-text-policy.php` to the php80 job. Run locally: PHP 8.5 + composer 2.9 are installed — run composer install in test/php/symfony and make the full Symfony fixture suite pass locally; paste the real output.
lanes.notes: Do NOT edit package.json: the main session adds scripts build:rich-text-policy / check:rich-text-policy (wired into test:ci:static) and exports['./rich-text-policy.json'] after merge — list exactly what to add in `shared`. Do not touch src/form/rich-text/rich-text-policy.js, the component, CSS, docs, CHANGELOG, roadmap. If Symfony 8.1's real behavior makes a plan rule impossible (e.g. it cannot force target), STOP and report instead of weakening the security assertions.

lanes.name: rt-component
lanes.goal:
td-components v0.88.0 ships : a form-associated ProseMirror editor, preset `comment` (bold, italic, underline, strike, link), for the dsuite site (comment/reply modal). READ FIRST, fully: docs/internal/plans/v0.88.0-rich-text.md (Lane B schema/html items + all of Lane C incl. 'Vòng đời' and 'Hộp link + focus') and docs/internal/research/rich-text-design-2026-10-30.md. Already committed on your base — USE, do not modify: src/vendor/td-rich-text-engine.js (generated ProseMirror bundle; exports exactly: Schema, PMDOMParser, DOMSerializer, Fragment, Slice, EditorState, TextSelection, Plugin, PluginKey, EditorView, toggleMark, baseKeymap, chainCommands, exitCode, keymap, history, undo, redo — need another export? STOP and report, do not edit the bundle) and src/form/rich-text/rich-text-policy.js (RICH_TEXT_POLICY, resolveFeatures → {features, unknown}, isSafeUrl(href,{allowHttp}) → cleaned string|null, normalizeLinkTarget, policyFor). Deliver: 1. src/form/rich-text/rich-text-schema.js: buildSchema(PM, features, { allowHttp, linkTarget }) → Schema. PM = the engine module passed in. Nodes doc(block+), paragraph

, text, hard_break
. Marks in THIS order (= nesting outermost→innermost): link, strong, em, u, s; only enabled ones. parseDOM: strong ← strong, b; em ← em, i; u ← u; s ← s, strike, del; link ← a[href] whose href passes isSafeUrl (getAttrs returns false otherwise → text kept, mark dropped). No style-based parse rules. toDOM: link → ['a', {href, rel: 'nofollow noopener', target?}] (target only when linkTarget is _self/_blank), others plain tags with NO attributes. 2. src/form/rich-text/rich-text-html.js: parseHtml(PM, schema, html) — new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html') (inert document; never insert source nodes into the page), remove script/style/template/iframe/object/embed/svg/math elements BEFORE PM parsing so their text never survives, then PMDOMParser.fromSchema(schema).parse(doc.body). serializeHtml(PM, schema, doc) → string via DOMSerializer into a container from document.implementation.createHTMLDocument('') and its innerHTML; a doc that is a single empty paragraph → ''. visibleText(doc) → string (paragraph boundary and hard_break = '\n'), used for required (trim empty) and maxlength (count code points: [...text].length). 3. src/form/td-rich-text.js: class TdRichText extends TdFormElement (src/base/td-form-element.js), customElements.define('td-rich-text'). Follow the plan's attribute/property/labels/DOM/keyboard/form/event contract exactly. Study how existing form components are structured (src/form/td-input-field.js for label/helper/error/validation contract, its _doRender override; src/base/td-base-element.js attributeChangedCallback → _doRender; td-form-element.js _syncEffectiveDisabled). The editor DOM is persistent: implement the plan's lifecycle (override _doRender: first time build shell + EditorView; afterwards sync in place). No innerHTML from site data anywhere; build DOM with createElement/textContent. Icons from the kit icon registry (see how td-action-button or others render icons; pick existing icons or report the ones missing — do NOT add icons). Warn once (console.warn) for unknown feature tokens. Toolbar: role=toolbar, aria-label = labels.toolbar, buttons with aria-pressed reflecting the marks at the selection, roving tabindex. Link dialog per plan. ProseMirror Trusted Types note goes in docs. 4. src/styles/components/rich-text.css in @layer td.component, follow docs/internal/design/liquid-glass.md (minimal surfaces) + docs/internal/design/touch.md (hover gate, pressed state, touch-action) + the input-field look (border, radius, focus ring tokens — reuse existing tokens/var chains; new tokens --td-rich-text-* only if needed, add each to test/tokens/golden.json 'added' textually without reformatting the file). Include the ProseMirror essentials scoped to .td-rich-text .ProseMirror (white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap; outline none on the editable with the focus ring on the box via :focus-within; .ProseMirror-hideselection rules; placeholder via a data attribute/class on an empty doc, NOT inline style). Dark mode via existing tokens, forced-colors, disabled/readonly. Register the file in src/styles/manifest.json (read scripts/build-css.mjs); run npm run build:css and commit td.css. CSP: no inline style attributes from the kit (CSSOM only when unavoidable). 5. package.json: exports['./rich-text'] = './src/form/td-rich-text.js' and './src/form/td-rich-text.js' in sideEffects; NOT in index.js. Extend src/package-manifest.test.js with the subpath assertion. 6. Stories src/form/td-rich-text.stories.js (plain HTML strings like other stories; Default, WithValue, Required+maxlength, Disabled/Readonly, LinkTarget blank) and docs/components/rich-text.md in the style of docs/components/dropdown.md (usage, attributes table, properties, events, labels, keyboard, value format/sanitization, 'server must sanitize again' with pointer to the PHP helper php/td-rich-text-policy.php (being written by another lane: RichTextPolicy::load + ::symfonyConfig($policy, $features, $allowHttp, $linkTarget)), Trusted Types policy name ProseMirrorClipboard, bundle size note ~68 KiB gzip); link it from the docs hubs. 7. src/form/td-rich-text.browser-test.js (@web/test-runner + chai, see existing *.browser-test.js): value round-trip + sanitization (script, onerror, javascript: link dropped, rel/target forced), form submit value + reset + required/tooLong validity, input/change events (change only when focus leaves the whole component, not when moving to the toolbar/dialog), toolbar aria-pressed + roving focus, Mod-b etc., link dialog apply/remove/cancel/Escape/invalid URL + focus return + selection restore, lifecycle: changing label/required/disabled/helper-text keeps the same editor node + undo works; changing features clears history; disconnect/reconnect keeps value.
lanes.notes: Hard parts: Opus. Do NOT edit src/vendor/, src/form/rich-text/rich-text-policy.js, php/, test/fixtures/, CHANGELOG, roadmap, version, dist/, module-graph.json, test/csp (main session adds CSP matrix states, a11y, touch cases after merge — list needed ones in `gates`). Run npm run check:css, npm run check:stories, node --test for the listed tests, and the browser test once on Chromium; paste real output. Mismatch between plan and real APIs → STOP and report.
